title: Kabatoast Bliss Bites
description: A simple recipe to make delicious bliss bites using kabatoast as a base. These bites are perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Crush kabatoast into fine crumbs and mix with brown sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together melted butter, vanilla extract, and eggs.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and cut into desired shapes.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool and serve with bliss.
